enonce.texte:
Write clear acceptance criteria for each user story using the Given-When-Then format.

User Story 1: As a customer, I want to add items to my shopping cart so that I can purchase multiple products.

User Story 2: As a user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access to my account.

questions.texte: Write acceptance criteria for User Story 1.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 
1. Given I am on the product page, when I click 'Add to Cart', then the item should be added to my shopping cart.
2. Given I have items in my cart, when I view my cart, then the total price should be updated correctly.
3. Given my cart is empty, when I view my cart, then a message should say 'Your cart is empty'.

questions.texte: Write acceptance criteria for User Story 2.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 
1. Given I am on the login page, when I click 'Forgot Password', then I should be taken to a password reset form.
2. Given I enter my registered email address, when I submit the form, then a password reset link should be sent to my email.
3. Given I receive the email, when I click the reset link, then I should be able to set a new password.
4. Given I set a new password, when I submit it, then my password should be updated and I should be able to log in.

enonce.texte:
You are writing a technical specification for a simple e-commerce system. The system includes the following components:

  • User Service - Manages user accounts, authentication, and profiles.
  • Product Service - Manages product inventory, categories, and details.
  • Order Service - Processes orders, payments, and shipments.
  • Notification Service - Sends emails, SMS, and push notifications.

For each component, write a brief description that includes:

  • Responsibility (what it does).
  • Key features (2-3 important functions).
  • External dependencies (other services or systems it interacts with).

questions.texte: Write the description for the User Service.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 
User Service
Responsibility: Manages user accounts, authentication, and profiles.
Key features: User registration and login, password reset, profile management.
External dependencies: Notification Service (for sending welcome emails), Database (for storing user data).

questions.texte: Write the description for the Product Service.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 
Product Service
Responsibility: Manages product inventory, categories, and details.
Key features: Adding/removing products, updating stock levels, searching products by category.
External dependencies: Database (for product data), Search Service (optional).

enonce.texte:
You are documenting a REST API for a simple task management application. The API endpoint is:
POST /api/tasks

The API expects the following request body:

{
  "title": "string (required)",
  "description": "string (optional)",
  "dueDate": "string (optional, ISO format)",
  "priority": "string (optional, values: low, medium, high)"
}

The API returns:

{
  "id": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "dueDate": "string",
  "priority": "string",
  "createdAt": "string",
  "updatedAt": "string"
}

Write clear documentation for this endpoint, including:

  • Endpoint URL
  • HTTP method
  • Request body description
  • Response body description
  • Error scenarios

questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 
Endpoint: POST /api/tasks
Description: Creates a new task in the system.

Request Body:
- title (string, required): The title of the task.
- description (string, optional): A detailed description of the task.
- dueDate (string, optional): The due date of the task in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
- priority (string, optional): The priority level. Allowed values: low, medium, high. Defaults to medium.

Response Body:
- id (string): The unique identifier of the created task.
- title (string): The title of the task.
- description (string): The description of the task.
- dueDate (string): The due date of the task.
- priority (string): The priority level.
- createdAt (string): Timestamp when the task was created.
- updatedAt (string): Timestamp when the task was last updated.

Error Scenarios:
- 400 Bad Request: If the request body is invalid (e.g., missing title).
- 401 Unauthorized: If the user is not authenticated.
- 500 Internal Server Error: If there is a server-side issue.

enonce.texte: Below is a description of a data model for a library management system. The system has three main entities: Book, Author, and Borrower. Write a detailed description of each entity, including its attributes, data types, and relationships.

questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 
Book
- id: integer (primary key) - Unique identifier for each book.
- title: string (required) - The title of the book.
- authorId: integer (foreign key to Author) - The ID of the author.
- isbn: string (optional) - The ISBN number of the book.
- publishedYear: integer (optional) - The year the book was published.
- availableCopies: integer (required) - The number of copies available for borrowing.

Exemple de réponse : 
Author
- id: integer (primary key) - Unique identifier for each author.
- name: string (required) - The full name of the author.
- biography: text (optional) - A short biography of the author.
- birthDate: date (optional) - The author's birth date.

Exemple de réponse : 
Borrower
- id: integer (primary key) - Unique identifier for each borrower.
- name: string (required) - The full name of the borrower.
- email: string (required) - The borrower's email address.
- phone: string (optional) - The borrower's phone number.
- borrowedBookIds: list of integers (foreign keys to Book) - The IDs of books currently borrowed.

enonce.texte:
You are the lead engineer on a project to develop a mobile application for booking taxi rides. Users will be able to:

  • Register and log in using their email or phone number.
  • Book a ride by entering a pickup and drop-off location.
  • View the estimated fare and driver details.
  • Make payments using a credit card or mobile money.
  • Rate the driver after the ride.

Write a comprehensive technical specification that includes:

  • Overview of the system.
  • Functional requirements (at least 5).
  • Non-functional requirements (at least 3).
  • Key system components and their responsibilities.
  • Data model for at least 2 entities.

questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse : 

**Technical Specification - Taxi Booking Mobile Application**

**1. Overview**
This document describes the technical requirements for a mobile application that allows users to book taxi rides, track their driver, and complete payments. The system will consist of a mobile app (iOS/Android) and a backend API.

**2. Functional Requirements**
1. The system must allow users to create an account using email or phone number.
2. The system must allow users to log in using their credentials.
3. The system must allow users to book a ride by entering pickup and drop-off locations.
4. The system must display an estimated fare and driver details before confirming the ride.
5. The system must support payments via credit card and mobile money.
6. The system must allow users to rate their driver after each ride.

**3. Non-functional Requirements**
1. The system must be able to handle up to 10,000 concurrent users.
2. The system must load the booking screen in under 2 seconds.
3. The system must be available 99.9% of the time.

**4. Key System Components**
- **User Service:** Manages user accounts, authentication, and profiles.
- **Booking Service:** Handles ride bookings, location tracking, and fare estimation.
- **Payment Service:** Processes payments and refunds.
- **Notification Service:** Sends push notifications for ride updates (e.g., driver assigned, ride started).
- **Rating Service:** Manages driver ratings and reviews.

**5. Data Model**

*User* (id, name, email, phone, passwordHash, createdAt, updatedAt)
*Booking* (id, userId, driverId, pickupLat, pickupLng, dropoffLat, dropoffLng, fare, status, paymentMethod, paymentStatus, rating, createdAt, updatedAt)
*Driver* (id, name, vehicleDetails, rating, available, locationLat, locationLng)
